subject: three snow-covered mountain layers
art_direction: 浅灰雪山在底部叠成三层，少量墨色树点像呼吸一样轻。
visible_description: 浅灰雪山在底部叠成三层，少量墨色树点像呼吸一样轻。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint three overlapping snow-covered ridges in diluted gray ink, keeping their strongest forms near the bottom. A few tiny dark tree marks sit on the nearest slope, giving scale without detail clutter. Reserve warm-white paper as snow and atmosphere, with faint blue wash in the valleys. The result should feel spacious, contemplative and gently rhythmic rather than dramatic. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
